notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
After recent feedback I made some changes mostly relevant for first-time players.
[list]
[*]New visual hint to help players notice an important change of objective later in the game
[*]Less strict rules for starting a new game after finishing one
[*]An adjustment for object readability
[/list]

notes.title: Soundtrack
notes.notes:
The game now includes it's soundtrack as 1 mp3 file. After updating you can find it in Steam's music player and the installation directory.
